scope: Saved JSON and frozen source/runtime installation hashes only. Stdlib arithmetic with struct binary32 rounding. No candidate imports, NumPy imports, model runs, new probes, data files, or training.

costs.unknown_additional: Supervisor final tail, preparation, tools and reviews are additional unknown nonzero costs; no strict global CPU or all-in memory guarantee.

limitations: Saved slopes independently recomputed from saved plus/minus losses. Raw losses and analytic gradients were not independently regenerated, and no full-parameter gradient proof is claimed.
Adam scalar recurrence independently recalculated only for preregistered72 model coordinates and4 fixture coordinates; saved gradient inputs are not independently regenerated.

B byte identity and singleton correctness rely on the reviewed frozen assertions having completed; raw images/checkpoints are intentionally not retained. A measured local sensitivity does not identify semantic class use, reconstruction benefit or generalization.
Reported finite-array counts and operation counters checked for completeness/consistency, not independent instrumentation of native operations.
Passing local dual-epsilon probes does not prove absence of ReLU kinks elsewhere.
This is exactly four synthetic model updates plus two tiny optimizer fixtures, not real TRAIN Q, model-quality evidence, or authorization to access/export TRAIN or heldouts.
The ordinary successful run does not qualify abnormal-signal paths, malicious runtime behavior, transient thread absence, or parent-death handling.
